authority_boundary: Definitions own meaning; compilation and views confer neither semantic acceptance nor operational permission.
confidence_policy: Evidence confidence and commitment confidence are separate. Exact authoring/source binding is not semantic acceptance or measured runtime conformance.
contradiction_route: Review exact successor changes; invalidate affected mappings/projections/qualifications.
history_policy: Candidate design only; no live event store or fabricated history. Later runtime binding must select real separate semantic/governance histories.
purpose: Represent business meaning, required outcomes and constraints without selecting implementation.
representation_policy: Each node binds a distinct exact subject revision, original source bytes and selector. Ontology records project artifact/design/mapping sources and do not become a second writable authority for them.
retrieval_policy: Read exact role/model/node IDs with source, standing and gaps.
